card.name: Partway into anatomy and procedure phrases
card.fires_on: Words inside surgical or vascular phrases, such as 'silicone' before 'oil', 'ven-ous' before 'line' or 'access', and 'the' before 'eye'. It marks a spot where a noun like oil, line or route is expected next.

modes.label: Venous word ending
modes.description: The 'ous' ending of 'venous' before line, access or route in infusion directions.

modes.description: Words in eye surgery text that come just before a noun such as oil, eye or iris.

modes.label: Other medical noun modifiers
modes.description: Words partway through other medical phrases, such as 'renal' before 'allograft' or 'wound' before 'dehiscence'.
modes.example: Impaired neurosurgical wound healing including<< wound>> dehiscence, delayed wound healing

card.writes: It suppresses odd tokens and promotes the word 'phase', so there is no sensible output effect.
card.plain: It fires on a word in the middle of a medical phrase, especially 'venous' and eye surgery terms, where the next noun is still to come.
